_meta.notes: SEED / ON-RECORD entries: real, well-documented historical export restrictions demonstrating the live exposure engine. Each is tagged status=historical and cited to the IFPRI Export Restrictions Tracker. Current status may have changed since announcement — verify against the live IFPRI tracker before treating any as currently in force. Exposure (who's hit) is computed live from the atlas by restrictionExposure() and is real regardless of a restriction's current status. No fabricated restrictions.
